description: Explore the EUIPO's harmonised Nice goods-and-services classification (TMClass) — "find accepted goods-and-services terms for 'software' in Nice class 9". Use when preparing a trademark filing or checking whether a term is already a recognised, pre-classified term. Returns matching terms with their Nice class and concept id, plus raw. Example: euipo_search_goods_services({ term: "software", nice_class: 9, language: "en", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

include_term_variants.description: Include term variants in the results (default false).

language.description: EU official language code for the search and results, e.g. "en", "es", "de", "fr". Required by the upstream API; defaults to "en".

nice_class.description: Nice classification class number(s) to restrict the search to, e.g. [9] or [9, 42]. Also accepts a single integer.

parent_concept_id.description: Restrict to children of this taxonomy concept id (for browsing the classification tree).

term.description: Text to search for within goods-and-services terms, e.g. "software".

name: euipo_search_goods_services
title: Euipo Search Goods Services
